item.title: GTA 6 Actor Says Rockstar Made Their Non-Binary Character Unkillable
item.description: The state of Leonida has thousands of inhabitants, each one with their own story. One of them is Cygnus, not only Vice City's museum curator, but also the first non-binary character in Grand Theft Auto history. In a detailed Instagram post , actor Jesse James Rose revealed that they played Cygnus and shared their experience working with Rockstar Games on the set of GTA 6 .

item.title: Every Future Driving Game Needs to Steal This GTA 6 Feature
item.description: I've written numerous times about my love for open-world driving games. I love racing, but I also love cruising, taking in the landscape, setting out on road trips. My heart belongs to Test Drive Unlimited . I've written a tourist guide for the Forza Horizon series . One of my games of the year is the Road Trip DLC for American Truck Simulator .

item.title: Sold-out Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 Is Coming Back Very Soon
item.description: In September 2026, Nintendo announced a new Switch 2 and controller set to commemorate the Zelda franchise's 40th anniversary and the release of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake . While the game quickly became a massive hit, overshadowed only by the launch of GTA 6 , the Switch 2 set unfortunately sold out in a matter of seconds . But there's good news: The Zelda 40th anniversary edition Switch 2 is coming back soon.

item.title: 72 Years Later, Lord of the Rings Officially Reveals Why Sauron Is So Evil
item.description: Sauron is one of the most famous villains of all time, but The Lord of the Rings doesn’t really explore why the Dark Lord is so obsessed with conquering all of Middle-earth. The prequel series The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power has been working to make Sauron (Charlie Vickers) more complex — which isn’t hard since he gets to have conversations with other characters rather than solely appear as an ominous eye. He’s a master of deception who has appeared in multiple guises to further his schemes, but in one of the latest episodes released Wednesday, Sauron gets honest and reveals his true motivations.

item.title: 6 Funniest Far Side Comics Starring the Devil
item.description: In the 1980s and 1990s, nothing in the funny pages was quite as dark as The Far Side . Lucy van Pelt pulling the football away from Charlie Brown as he was about to kick it is about as dark as things got in Peanuts . And in Garfield , the lazy cat’s darkest running gag also revolved around a kick — when he’d kick Odie the dog off a table.

item.title: 53 Years Later, The Greatest Closing Line In Sci-Fi History Is Still The Best Book Quote Of The 1970s
item.description: The canon of science-fiction literature is home to countless unforgettable endings, from 1984 ’s short but devastating retrospective ("He loved Big Brother") to The Three-Body Problem ’s defiant reminder that humanity cannot be so easily wiped out. The best sci-fi endings don't offer comfortable closure. Instead, they reframe everything that came before. In their closing lines, great sci-fi novelists leave readers suspended in the aftermath, forced to stew in the terrifying logic of cold technology, the fragility of human nature, and the vast expanse of space.

item.title: 10 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Cavemen and Their Early Innovations
item.description: Gary Larson’s comic strip The Far Side broke the mold of traditional newspaper comics by not having a recurring cast of characters. Peanuts had Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Linus and the rest of the gang. Garfield had Garfield, Odie, Jon, and some others. Calvin and Hobbes had Calvin, Hobbes, and Calvin’s parents. But The Far Side introduced new characters and scenarios every single day.
